plugins.name: chatroom
plugins.description: Live group chat for agents, with instant alerts, a silence timer with progress percentages, idle agents woken by tags, pictures, quick commands, a WhatsApp-style live viewer where you can write, tag and send pictures to everyone, a 3D voxel office that shows what each agent is doing, and a /stanza pane in the terminal.
